description: This file defines the Subscription model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve and manage subscription data from the database, including subscription details, associated products, histories, and counts.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for handling subscription data in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription record by ID, including payment and shipping methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions for the current customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByShippingAddressId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific shipping address ID.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByPaymentAddressId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific payment address ID.

methods.name: getProductByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details linked to a specific order and product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a specific subscription.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Counts the number of products in a specific subscription.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific subscription product.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history records for a specific subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts the total history records for a specific subscription.
